name: read-limits
summary: A task's agents read at most 500 times a day across every operation whose definition is a read; the 501st read that day is refused.
protects: the task's grant counts every read, by the definition's access, and refuses the 501st read in a day (COUNT_LIMIT_REACHED)
excludes: writes: the count covers reads only
what a read returns: the count is of reads, not of rows or bytes
reads spread across several tasks or grants, each counted on its own
the limit is an example: change it in a new grant before relying on it
grant: a count of at most 500 reads a day, across every operation whose definition is a read
